svg.title: The layers of relate
svg.desc: Surfaces sit on top: the CLI and relate serve with Bolt, HTTP and MCP; the Python client and the WebAssembly build; and the C ABI that the Node.js, Java, Go and Swift clients load. Every surface calls one public Rust API, relate::Database. Under it, a statement goes through the parser, the planner and the executor, which runs against the in-memory graph and its indexes. Storage keeps the graph durable with a write-ahead log and snapshots in a directory, a .rl file or memory.
